verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for an identity-verification service, since such a service could ship rules or scheduled workflows, so the axis applies. The pack shows no product-native way for users to set up autonomous background automations. Webhook events that let 'your integration' trigger reactions, reusable flow configurations, and blocklisting are developer building blocks or adjacent controls, not a user-configurable automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
